$comment: Weak-copyleft npm packages (MPL, LGPL…) accepted by name, as deny.toml does for Cargo (ADR-0021). Used by scripts/check-licenses.mjs and server/scripts/check-licenses.mjs: any other weak-copyleft package fails the license gate until it is reviewed and listed here. Only unmodified dependencies qualify.

lightningcss.reason: Optional CSS engine of vite 7, installed in server/ through vitest 4 (test tooling, never shipped).
